subject.title: [Feature]: When messages are merged and processed, the agent event is expected to carry the original runId(s)

question: Should Gateway agent/chat events gain an additive original-run lineage field for merged queued work, and what exact field semantics should clients rely on?
rationale: The implementation shape is clear, but the stable public Gateway event contract needs maintainer-owned naming and correlation semantics before automation changes it.

options.title: Add additive lineage field
options.body: Expose all original queued run IDs, such as `originalRunIds`, while keeping the executed `runId` unchanged for compatibility.

options.title: Canonicalize to one queued ID
options.body: Select the first or last queued ID as the public run ID, trading simpler clients for ambiguous merged-message lineage.

options.title: Document existing correlation paths
options.body: Leave events singular and direct clients toward history/idempotency correlation, which does not solve live merged-event correlation for this report.

recommendation.title: Add additive lineage field
recommendation.body: Expose all original queued run IDs, such as `originalRunIds`, while keeping the executed `runId` unchanged for compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: He appears in the feature history for the agent steering queue and is the strongest available routing owner for the public lineage decision.
